title: Playboy Magazine March 1963 Bertrand Russell Interview Graham Greene Silverstein
conditionDescription: Toning, edge and corner wear, light creasing, spine rubbing. Spine intact, complete. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, March 1963 issue. Cover price 60 cents. Interview with Bertrand Russell; a new short story by Graham Greene; "A Fledgling of L'Amour" by Alexander King; "The Playboy Cars" by Ken W. Purdy; the Playmate of the Year; and "Silverstein in Miami," Shel Silverstein's cartoon antics. Orange towel cover. Back cover carries a 1963 Dodge Dart ad.

Condition: pre-owned with wear consistent with age - toning, edge and corner wear, light creasing and spine rubbing. Spine intact, complete. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
